clips.title: The story
paras: On an island in western Ashenvale, Teronis' Corpse lies in Lake Falathim. The night elf scout left Astranaar to find Dartol's Rod and help cleanse the forest.

Teronis was sent from Astranaar to recover Dartol's Rod. Raene Wolfrunner gave the night elf scout this charge, seeking an ancient relic that could cleanse corrupted woodland magic. Teronis searched the waters of Lake Falathim, but hostile murlocs swarmed the island and killed him. His journal remains there, while the murlocs took the rod's radiant gemstone.
